name: Doki Doki Dollmaker
source:
Lyle (the player-character) must move away with his older brother Cole after the sudden and unfortunate passing of their parents. To occupy his mind during the long road trip to their new home, Lyle makes five plush dolls using some leftover materials found in an old sewing kit. Due to the magical properties of the sewing kit and Lyle’s cry for help (brought about by loss, unfamiliarity, and bullying at school), the dolls come to life! The narrative focuses around Lyle and his relationship with the five dolls. He has a lot to teach them, but there’s a lot he can learn from them too.

[From [url=http://dokidokidollmaker.tumblr.com/story] Tumblr[/url]]
translation:
在父母突然不幸去世后，莱尔（玩家角色）必须与他的哥哥科尔一起搬走。为了在前往新家的长途旅行中集中精力，莱尔用旧针线包中的一些剩余材料制作了五个毛绒娃娃。由于针线包的神奇特性和莱尔的呼救声（因失落、陌生和学校欺凌而引起），娃娃们活了过来！故事围绕莱尔和他与五个娃娃的关系展开。他有很多东西要教给他们，但他也可以从他们身上学到很多东西。

[来自[url=http://dokidokidollmaker.tumblr.com/story] ​​Tumblr[/url]]
